favorites.loginBody: With an account you can save businesses and get an alert when a new hour opens up.
favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on a business to save it here.

alerts.heading: Tell me when something opens up
alerts.bodyAny: Leave your e-mail address. We will write to you as soon as a business puts a new hour online.
alerts.bodyCity: Leave your e-mail address. We will write to you as soon as a new hour opens up in {city}.
alerts.bodyCategory: Leave your e-mail address. We will write to you as soon as a new hour opens up in the {category} category.
alerts.bodyCityCategory: Leave your e-mail address. We will write to you as soon as a new hour opens up in the {category} category in {city}.
alerts.bodySalon: Leave your e-mail address. We will write to you as soon as {salon} puts a new hour online.
alerts.doneGuest: Almost there. We sent a confirmation link to {email}. The alert only starts once you click it.
alerts.fine: You can unsubscribe at any time with the link in every e-mail. We send at most one e-mail every three hours.
alerts.confirmed: Your alert is on. You will get an e-mail as soon as a matching hour opens up.
alerts.off: Your alert is off. You will get no more e-mails about it.
alerts.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Set up a new alert below.
